role: Technical correction of numerical guided diagnosis only; raw main andH6-H8 remain unchanged.
final_answer_marker: A line starting Answer: commits to final field; earlier reasoning lines cannot start that reserved marker.
intended_policy: Zero or more free reasoning lines, then exactly one final Answer: legal-value line; total1024 tokens. The final-answer parser and legal answers are unchanged.
reason: Original mandatory-newline grammar rejected legitimate one-line answers. A universal wildcard could also absorb an invalid Answer field. This grammar accepts bare answers and commits the reserved final marker, preventing that escape.
cpu_regression: All4 bare answers and three reasoning-prefix forms accept proper EOS. Prefixes Answer:0/1/2.0/9/B rejected immediately; incomplete Answer and5 or... prefixes reject EOS.
run_policy: All6 reasoning conditions x300 numbers rerun uniformly; original1800 guided predictions retained separately as implementation-diagnostic v1, never overwritten.
